methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.sub: How each SDQ·MIP index is built: the gate cycle, the real sources per axis, the honest validation of every score, and the anti-fabrication doctrine that sustains them. Every score is reconstructed from here.
methodology.secGatesHint: Each axis goes through five gates in order (A→E), with operability (F) transversal. No gate is skipped: it defines the partial Definition of Done.
methodology.secDoctrineHint: SDQ's methodological differentiator: no figure is invented. It is symmetric in both directions.
methodology.secSourcesHint: What feeds each index in production today. The badge distinguishes real measured data from indices with sub-components on a declared rubric.
methodology.secValidationHint: Gate E: the proof that the score discriminates real outcomes. Pulled live from each axis's persisted backtest reports.
methodology.secWeightsHint: Weight transparency sustains explainability: every score is reconstructed from these weights, versioned in doctrine.
methodology.secScqaHint: The narrative layer: each axis with real data explains its read with Claude, under a fixed framework.

gates.aDesc: Live connector, replicable by period and validated against the issuer's official portal.
gates.bDesc: Automated tests + human verification of figures against the source. Data is tested, not assumed.
gates.cDesc: Axis features and index, explainable and modelable: every score is reconstructed from its components.
gates.dDesc: SCQA narrative generated with real Claude. A page without an insight is not considered done.
gates.eDesc: Score validated against realized outcomes. Without this, a score is never communicated as predictive.
gates.fDesc: Every recurring operation lives in the UI, monitored and schedulable. Transversal to all gates.

axes.n1Source: SIB / SIMBAD + OCR trusts and FX houses
axes.n3Source: BCRD value added · ENCFT employment · TSS wages

methodology.sourcesNote: Real + rubric: the bulk is real measured data; sub-components without a live source (financial inclusion in Social; business and talent in the sectoral IAI) use a declared rubric, flagged on each screen. Monitor: the macro-fiscal axis watches the country's pulse; it does not emit a predictive score, hence no backtest.

doctrine.card1Title: Real data or declared rubric — never invent
doctrine.card1Body: Every figure shown is real measured data from an official source, or a declared rubric value with its visible badge. There is no third state: a data gap is labeled N/A, not filled with an estimate that looks like data.
doctrine.card1Li1: A score without a backtest is not communicated as predictive.
doctrine.card1Li2: Every rubric sub-component carries its badge on the axis screen.
doctrine.card1Li3: Confidence intervals are reported as-is: if they cross zero, we say so.
doctrine.card2Body: A “can't be done” / “the data doesn't exist” is a claim that must earn its evidence bar, exactly like data. It is the symmetric of the previous rule: data claimed as non-existent = suspicious.
doctrine.card2Body2: Before declaring an impossibility we exhaust the source's full catalog, the constrained queries, the issuer's alternative portals and what is already being pulled. A scope reduction by impossibility is not decided silently: it is surfaced with the search trail.

validation.title: Honest validation — backtest per axis
validation.subtitle: Each score is validated against realized outcomes (Gate E). Live figures from the persisted reports.
validation.warnBody: Where the confidence interval crosses zero we declare it inconclusive by power (small panel), not a refutation — honesty about the strength of the signal, never makeup.
validation.error: Could not load the validation reports.

weights.esgDir: higher score = more resilience / lower climate risk

scqa.title: Explainable narrative, not a black-box opinion
scqa.subtitle: Situation · Complication · Question · Answer — the insight anchors in the axis figures, it does not replace them.
scqa.p1: Each axis screen with real data generates its insight with real Claude under the SCQA pattern: it starts from the observed state, names the tension, poses the decision question and answers with an actionable read — always referring to the figures visible on the page.
scqa.p2: The pattern is two-phase: first the data is rendered (figures, breakdown, backtest); the insight is requested separately and never blocks the read. If AI is unavailable, the page is still complete with its data. The narrative enriches; the data rules.
